goal: Ship Transcriber — a production-quality, local-first audio/video transcription CLI and Python library built on faster-whisper — at version 1.0.0: typed, tested, documented, CI-gated, packaged, with the graph loop that built it recorded in-repo.

nodes.title: Graph-loop machinery, plan, dev environment
nodes.spec: Single-writer bootstrap (this file's own scheduling layer): graphloop.py engine, graph.json, protocol README, PLAN.md, .gitignore, provisioned .venv with runtime (faster-whisper, click, rich) and dev (ruff, mypy, pytest, pytest-cov, build, twine) dependencies.

nodes.title: Package scaffold: pyproject, QA config, importable skeleton
nodes.spec:
Create the package skeleton for `transcriber` (import package `transcriber`, src layout).

- `pyproject.toml`: build backend hatchling; project name `transcriber-cli`, version 1.0.0 single-sourced from `src/transcriber/__init__.py` via hatch `[tool.hatch.version]` (path = src/transcriber/__init__.py); requires-python `>=3.10`; dependencies: `faster-whisper>=1.1,<2`, `click>=8.1`, `rich>=13`; optional-dependency group `dev` = ruff, mypy, pytest, pytest-cov, build, twine; console script `transcriber = "transcriber.cli:main"` (cli module lands in a later node — the entry point declaration is still correct now); readme = README.md — NOTE README.md does not exist yet and hatchling metadata build would fail, so do NOT reference readme in [project] yet (a later node adds it); license = MIT with LICENSE file reference; authors: Josef D. Long; keywords, classifiers (Development Status :: 5, Environment :: Console, Topic :: Multimedia :: Sound/Audio :: Speech, Python versions 3.10-3.13, MIT, Typing :: Typed).
- Tool config in pyproject: `[tool.ruff]` line-length 100, target py310, lint select = ["E","F","W","I","UP","B","C4","SIM","RUF"], per-file-ignores for tests if needed; `[tool.mypy]` strict = true, files scoped to src, `ignore_missing_imports` NOT set globally — instead `[[tool.mypy.overrides]]` module `faster_whisper.*` ignore_missing_imports true (it ships no stubs), same for `av.*` if needed; `[tool.pytest.ini_options]` testpaths=["tests"], addopts `-q`; `[tool.coverage.run]` source=["transcriber"], `[tool.coverage.report]` show_missing.
- `src/transcriber/__init__.py`: `__version__ = "1.0.0"`, module docstring describing the library; keep public re-exports minimal for now (later nodes extend it).
- `src/transcriber/py.typed` empty marker; hatn't forget hatchling package include for py.typed (src layout auto-detects packages; py.typed included by default with hatchling? verify by building? no build here — just ensure `[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]` packages = ["src/transcriber"]).
- `tests/__init__.py` empty; `tests/conftest.py` placeholder with a `repo_root` fixture.
- `Makefile` with phony targets: `install` (editable + dev), `lint` (ruff check + format --check), `type` (mypy src), `test` (pytest), `cov` (pytest --cov=transcriber --cov-report=term-missing --cov-fail-under=85), `check` (lint+type+test), `build`, `gauntlet` (check + cov + build + scripts/smoke_install.sh if present). Use `.venv/bin/` prefixed tools so make works without activation.
- `.editorconfig` standard (utf-8, lf, 4-space python, 2-space yaml/json).
- Extend `.gitignore` for python artifacts (dist/, *.egg-info, .mypy_cache, .ruff_cache, .pytest_cache, .coverage, htmlcov/, __pycache__/) keeping existing entries.
- Finally run `.venv/bin/pip install -q -e .` so `import transcriber` resolves for every later lane (allowed: install is an environment action, not a file write outside owned paths).

nodes.title: Transcript data model and timestamp utilities
nodes.gate: .venv/bin/ruff check src/transcriber/model.py src/transcriber/timestamps.py tests/test_model.py tests/test_timestamps.py && .venv/bin/mypy src && .venv/bin/pytest tests/test_model.py tests/test_timestamps.py
nodes.spec:
Engine-agnostic transcript data model in `src/transcriber/model.py` (frozen, slotted dataclasses):

- `Word(start: float, end: float, text: str, probability: float | None = None)`
- `Segment(id: int, start: float, end: float, text: str, words: tuple[Word, ...] = (), avg_logprob: float | None = None, no_speech_prob: float | None = None)` — `text` stored stripped.
- `Transcript(segments: tuple[Segment, ...], language: str | None, language_probability: float | None, duration: float, source: str, engine: str, model: str)` with properties `text` (segments joined by newline), `is_empty`, `word_count`; `__iter__` over segments; `to_dict()` -> plain-JSON-serializable dict with a `schema_version: 1` key and ISO-free floats; classmethod `from_dict()` round-tripping exactly. Validate in `__post_init__`: negative times, end < start, raise ValueError.
- `src/transcriber/timestamps.py`: `format_timestamp(seconds: float, *, style: Literal["srt", "vtt", "clock"]) -> str` — srt `HH:MM:SS,mmm`, vtt `HH:MM:SS.mmm`, clock `H:MM:SS` (no ms, hours unpadded, for human display); clamp negatives to 0; handle >= 100 hours without breaking width assumptions (grow HH field); round milliseconds half-up deterministically from float seconds. Also `format_duration(seconds: float) -> str` humanised (e.g. `1h 02m 03s`, `42.5s`).

Tests: construction + validation errors, text/word_count properties, to_dict/from_dict round-trip equality, timestamp goldens including 0, 59.9994 rounding edge (must not emit `60,000` ms — carry into seconds), 1h boundary, 100h, negative clamp, unicode text preserved.

nodes.title: Error taxonomy and configuration
nodes.gate: .venv/bin/ruff check src/transcriber/errors.py src/transcriber/config.py tests/test_config.py && .venv/bin/mypy src && .venv/bin/pytest tests/test_config.py
nodes.spec:
`src/transcriber/errors.py`: exception taxonomy rooted at `TranscriberError(Exception)` with subclasses `ConfigError`, `InputError` (further `AudioNotFoundError`, `UnsupportedFormatError`), `EngineError` (further `EngineNotAvailableError`, `ModelLoadError`, `TranscriptionFailedError`), `OutputError`. Each carries a human-actionable message; `EngineNotAvailableError` includes the pip install hint in its default message.

`src/transcriber/config.py`: frozen dataclass `TranscriberConfig` with fields and defaults: `model: str = "small"`, `engine: str = "faster-whisper"`, `device: str = "auto"`, `compute_type: str = "auto"` (validated against faster-whisper accepted set: auto/default/int8/int8_float16/int8_float32/int16/float16/float32/bfloat16), `language: str | None = None` (None = auto-detect; validate as 2-3 letter lowercase code when set), `task: str = "transcribe"` (or `translate`), `vad: bool = True`, `word_timestamps: bool = False`, `beam_size: int = 5` (>=1), `temperature: float = 0.0` (0..1), `initial_prompt: str | None = None`. Validation in `__post_init__` raising `ConfigError` with the offending value named. `replace(**overrides)` helper returning a new validated config (filtering None-valued overrides so CLI can pass only what was set). `from_env(environ: Mapping[str, str] | None = None) -> TranscriberConfig` reading `TRANSCRIBER_MODEL`, `TRANSCRIBER_ENGINE`, `TRANSCRIBER_DEVICE`, `TRANSCRIBER_COMPUTE_TYPE`, `TRANSCRIBER_LANGUAGE`, `TRANSCRIBER_TASK`, `TRANSCRIBER_VAD` (bool: 1/0/true/false/yes/no), `TRANSCRIBER_WORD_TIMESTAMPS`, `TRANSCRIBER_BEAM_SIZE`, `TRANSCRIBER_TEMPERATURE`, `TRANSCRIBER_INITIAL_PROMPT`; bad values raise ConfigError naming the variable. Module-level `KNOWN_MODELS: tuple[str, ...]` = (tiny, tiny.en, base, base.en, small, small.en, medium, medium.en, large-v1, large-v2, large-v3, large-v3-turbo, turbo, distil-small.en, distil-medium.en, distil-large-v2, distil-large-v3) — unknown model names are permitted (HF repo ids / local paths) but a helper `is_known_model(name)` exists for CLI hints.

Tests: defaults, each validation failure, env parsing happy/sad paths incl. bool coercion and unset-vs-empty, replace() override filtering.

nodes.title: Input discovery and validation
nodes.spec:
`src/transcriber/audio.py`: media input handling, no decoding (engines decode).

- `SUPPORTED_EXTENSIONS: frozenset[str]` — audio: .wav .mp3 .m4a .flac .ogg .oga .opus .aac .wma .aiff .aif .mka; video containers PyAV can demux: .mp4 .mkv .mov .avi .webm .m4v .mpg .mpeg .ts. Lowercase with dot.
- `is_supported(path: Path) -> bool` by suffix, case-insensitive.
- `collect_inputs(paths: Sequence[Path], *, recursive: bool = False) -> list[Path]`: for each argument — missing path raises `AudioNotFoundError` naming it; an explicit file with unsupported suffix raises `UnsupportedFormatError` listing supported ones; a directory is scanned (glob `*` or recursive `**/*`) keeping only supported files, silently skipping others; empty final result raises `AudioNotFoundError('no supported media found', ...)`. Result: deduplicated (resolved path), deterministic sort, hidden dotfiles skipped in directory scans but allowed when named explicitly.

Tests with tmp_path fixtures: explicit file ok, bad suffix raises with message listing formats, missing raises, dir scan filters and sorts, recursive on/off, dedupe of overlapping args (dir + file inside it), hidden-file policy, empty-dir raises.

nodes.title: Output formatters (txt, srt, vtt, json, tsv, md)
nodes.spec:
Package `src/transcriber/formats/` rendering a `Transcript` to text deterministically. `base.py`: `Formatter` ABC — attributes `name: ClassVar[str]`, `extension: ClassVar[str]`; `render(transcript: Transcript) -> str` (always ends with exactly one trailing newline, `\n` line endings). `__init__.py`: registry — `FORMATTERS: dict[str, Formatter]` instances keyed by name, `get_formatter(name) -> Formatter` raising `OutputError` with available names on miss, `available_formats() -> tuple[str, ...]` sorted.

- `txt`: one segment text per line.
- `srt` (`srt.py`): standard SubRip — 1-based counter, `HH:MM:SS,mmm --> HH:MM:SS,mmm` via timestamps.format_timestamp(style="srt"), text, blank line between cues.
- `vtt`: `WEBVTT` header + blank line, cues with dot-millisecond times, no counters.
- `json`: `json.dumps(transcript.to_dict(), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)`.
- `tsv`: header `start\tend\ttext`, millisecond-integer start/end (matching openai-whisper's tsv convention), tabs/newlines inside text collapsed to spaces.
- `md`: `# Transcript of <source>` + metadata lines (engine, model, language, duration humanised) + blank + `**[H:MM:SS]** text` per segment using clock style.

Empty transcript renders valid minimal output for every format (e.g. srt = empty string + newline policy documented, vtt = header only). Tests: golden strings for a 2-segment fixture incl unicode + >1h timestamp, empty-transcript behaviour per format, registry hit/miss, every formatter's output ends with single trailing newline, tsv tab-safety.

nodes.title: Engine abstraction: faster-whisper + mock
nodes.spec:
Package `src/transcriber/engines/`.

- `base.py`: `TranscriptionEngine` ABC — `name: ClassVar[str]`; `transcribe(self, path: Path, config: TranscriberConfig) -> Transcript`; optional `close()` default no-op.
- `mock.py`: `MockEngine` — deterministic, offline; constructor accepts optional fixed segments; default behaviour synthesises two segments ("[mock transcription of <stem>]" style) with duration derived from file size, sets language `en`, engine `mock`, model `mock`. Raises `TranscriptionFailedError` if the path's stem contains `FAIL` (lets pipeline/CLI tests exercise error isolation deterministically). Registered so `--engine mock` works end-to-end.
- `faster_whisper.py`: `FasterWhisperEngine` — IMPORTANT: import faster_whisper lazily inside a helper, converting ImportError to `EngineNotAvailableError`; module must import cleanly (and mypy-check) without faster_whisper installed. Introspect the INSTALLED package in .venv to match the real API (check `WhisperModel.__init__` and `.transcribe` signatures with `.venv/bin/python -c "import inspect, faster_whisper; ..."` before writing conversion code). Behaviour: cache `WhisperModel` per (model, device, compute_type) on the engine instance; map config -> transcribe kwargs (language, task, beam_size, temperature, initial_prompt, vad_filter, word_timestamps); `device="auto"` and `compute_type="auto"`-> faster-whisper accepts "auto"/"default" — verify exact accepted literals from the installed package and map "auto" compute to "default" if needed; wrap model construction errors in `ModelLoadError`, transcription errors in `TranscriptionFailedError`; consume the segments GENERATOR fully (list()) converting to model.Segment/Word tuples (strip text), build Transcript with info.language, info.language_probability, info.duration, engine name `faster-whisper`, model name as configured.
- `__init__.py`: `get_engine(name: str) -> type[TranscriptionEngine]`-style registry returning INSTANCES lazily (`create_engine(name)`), `available_engines()`; unknown -> `EngineError` naming available.

Tests (offline): mock engine determinism + FAIL trigger; registry; faster-whisper option mapping and segment conversion by injecting a fake `faster_whisper` module into `sys.modules` via monkeypatch (fake WhisperModel capturing ctor/transcribe kwargs, yielding fake segments with words) — assert lazy import error surfaces as EngineNotAvailableError when module truly absent (simulate with monkeypatch making import raise), assert generator is exhausted, texts stripped, info propagated.

nodes.title: Transcription pipeline / batch service
nodes.spec:
`src/transcriber/pipeline.py` — the library facade tying inputs -> engine -> formatters -> files.

- `@dataclass FileResult`: input path, ok flag, transcript | None, outputs written (list[Path]), error message | None, elapsed seconds (measured via time.perf_counter but tests must not assert wall-clock values).
- `@dataclass BatchResult`: results list; properties `ok_count`, `error_count`, `all_ok`; `exit_code` property -> 0 all ok, 1 any per-file failure.
- `class Transcriber`: ctor `(config: TranscriberConfig | None = None, *, engine: TranscriptionEngine | None = None)` — explicit engine injection wins, else `create_engine(config.engine)`. Methods: `transcribe_file(path: Path) -> Transcript` (single file, raises on failure); `transcribe_batch(inputs: Sequence[Path], *, formats: Sequence[str] = ("txt",), output_dir: Path | None = None, overwrite: bool = False, recursive: bool = False, on_event: Callable[[PipelineEvent], None] | None = None) -> BatchResult` — collects via audio.collect_inputs, validates formatter names up front (fail fast with OutputError before transcribing anything), per file: emit `file_started`, transcribe, write each format, emit `file_finished` or `file_failed`; engine/input errors for one file are caught (TranscriberError, OSError) and recorded, never abort the batch; unexpected exceptions propagate.
- `PipelineEvent` dataclass (kind: Literal[file_started, file_finished, file_failed], path, index, total, message | None, result: FileResult | None).
- Output naming: `<output_dir or input parent>/<input stem>.<fmt extension>`; `output_dir` created with parents; when not overwriting, existing target -> record as failed with clear message (no silent skip, no clobber); collision of two inputs with same stem targeting same output_dir -> second gets `.1` style disambiguating suffix before extension... NO — keep predictable: detect duplicate stems targeting the same directory up front and record the later one as failed with an explanatory error (documented behaviour). Write text with UTF-8 encoding, single write per file via a temp-then-rename in the same directory for atomicity, wrapped in OutputError on OSError.
- Also update `src/transcriber/__init__.py` re-exports? NOT owned — instead expose everything importable from `transcriber.pipeline`; the cli node (descendant of scaffold's owner chain) finalises `__init__` re-exports.

Tests use MockEngine and tmp_path: batch happy path writes all formats with exact expected paths; FAIL file isolates error and exit_code 1; overwrite=False refuses, =True replaces; output_dir creation; duplicate-stem policy; events sequence ordering and totals; formatter validation fail-fast; atomicity (no partial file on simulated formatter raise — monkeypatch a formatter to throw mid-batch).

nodes.title: Click CLI with rich progress
nodes.gate: .venv/bin/ruff check src/transcriber/cli.py src/transcriber/__main__.py src/transcriber/__init__.py tests/test_cli.py && .venv/bin/mypy src && .venv/bin/pytest tests/test_cli.py && .venv/bin/python -m transcriber --version
nodes.spec:
`src/transcriber/cli.py` — click group `main` (invoked by console script `transcriber` and `python -m transcriber`).

- Group-level `--version` (click.version_option from transcriber.__version__).
- `transcriber transcribe INPUTS... [options]`: `-f/--format` multiple (default txt, choices from available_formats()), `-o/--output-dir` path, `-m/--model` (default from config; unknown-but-allowed models print a hint when not in KNOWN_MODELS), `--engine` (choices available_engines()), `-l/--language`, `--task` choice transcribe/translate, `--device` choice auto/cpu/cuda, `--compute-type`, `--beam-size` int, `--temperature` float, `--initial-prompt`, `--word-timestamps/--no-word-timestamps`, `--vad/--no-vad`, `-r/--recursive`, `--overwrite`, `--stdout` (single input + single format only: print rendered output to stdout instead of writing files, error 2 otherwise), `-q/--quiet`, `-v/--verbose`. Build TranscriberConfig from env first (`from_env`) then CLI overrides via replace(); ConfigError/InputError/OutputError -> click.UsageError-style message on stderr, exit 2. Rich Progress (transient, disabled when quiet or not a TTY or --stdout) driven by pipeline events; after batch a rich table summary (file, status, duration, outputs) unless quiet; errors always printed to stderr. Exit with BatchResult.exit_code (0 ok, 1 partial/all failures, 2 usage/config).
- `transcriber formats` — table of format name + extension + one-line description.
- `transcriber models` — table of KNOWN_MODELS with parameter counts/notes (tiny 39M ... large-v3 1.5B, turbo 809M distilled; .en English-only; distil english-only) and a note that any HF CTranslate2 repo id or local path is accepted.
- `transcriber info` — version, python, platform, engine availability (faster-whisper importable? version), config-from-env dump.
- stdout discipline: transcript content only via --stdout; everything else human output; use click.echo/rich console on stderr for progress/log lines so --stdout pipes stay clean.
- `src/transcriber/__main__.py`: `from transcriber.cli import main; main()` guarded.
- Finalise `src/transcriber/__init__.py` public API: re-export `Transcriber`, `TranscriberConfig`, `Transcript`, `Segment`, `Word`, `TranscriptionEngine`, `MockEngine`, error taxonomy, `__version__`; define `__all__`; keep import cost low (no faster_whisper import at package import time — verify with a test asserting `faster_whisper` not in sys.modules after `import transcriber`).

Tests with CliRunner (mix_stderr=False if click>=8.2 supports; check installed click API): --version, --help, formats/models/info run; transcribe with --engine mock over tmp files writes outputs + exit 0; FAIL file -> exit 1 with error on stderr; bad format name -> exit 2; --stdout single file prints rendered txt exactly and writes nothing; --stdout with 2 formats -> exit 2; env var override respected (TRANSCRIBER_MODEL) and CLI flag beats env; lazy-import test.

nodes.title: README, CONTRIBUTING, CHANGELOG
nodes.spec:
Production documentation.

- `README.md`: title + one-line pitch (local-first, privacy-preserving transcription powered by faster-whisper); CI badge (github actions workflow ci.yml on this repo AlpharomeroJL/Transcriber), Python versions badge, license badge (shields.io static badges fine); Features list; Install (`pip install .` from source for now — do NOT claim it is on PyPI; optional `pipx install .`; note ffmpeg NOT required because PyAV bundles decoding); Quickstart CLI examples (single file, batch to srt+vtt, --stdout piping, language/model selection, env vars); Model selection guidance table (tiny→large-v3-turbo with size/RAM/speed/quality tradeoffs; default `small`; recommend turbo on GPU, distil for English); Output formats table; Python API example (Transcriber + config + transcribe_batch with events); Configuration section documenting every TRANSCRIBER_* env var; How it works (faster-whisper/CTranslate2, VAD default on and why — hallucination on silence); Development section (make targets); note that the repo was built by an in-repo graph loop with a pointer to .graphloop/README.md; License MIT.
- `CONTRIBUTING.md`: dev setup (python -m venv, make install), make targets, style (ruff/mypy strict, tests required, offline deterministic tests), how gates/CI run, commit guidance.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: Keep-a-Changelog format, `## [1.0.0] - 2026-08-22` with Added summary of the feature set.
- `scripts/check_docs.py` (stdlib only): asserts README exists and mentions every CLI subcommand present in `transcriber.cli` (introspect the click group), every available format name, every TRANSCRIBER_* env var defined in config.py (introspect), the CI badge path `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, and that CHANGELOG contains the current `transcriber.__version__`; asserts CONTRIBUTING exists and mentions `make check`. Exits nonzero listing what is missing. This keeps docs honest and mechanically re-checkable.

nodes.title: GitHub Actions CI
nodes.spec:
`.github/workflows/ci.yml` — name CI; on push (branches main + claude/**) and pull_request; concurrency group cancel-in-progress; jobs:
- `lint`: ubuntu-latest, setup-python 3.12 with pip cache, `pip install -e .[dev]`... careful: dev extras named in pyproject optional-dependencies `dev`; run ruff check, ruff format --check, mypy src.
- `test`: matrix python 3.10/3.12/3.13 on ubuntu-latest, install `.[dev]`, run `pytest --cov=transcriber --cov-report=term --cov-fail-under=85`.
- `build`: needs lint+test, `pip install build twine`, `python -m build`, `twine check dist/*`, upload-artifact dist.
Pin action majors (checkout@v4, setup-python@v5). Also `.github/dependabot.yml` weekly for pip + github-actions ecosystems.
Gate note: Actions cannot execute locally; the gate proves the YAML parses (pyyaml is available in the venv transitively — verify, else `python -c` with a minimal yaml check via ruamel? faster-whisper does not pull yaml; onnxruntime? IF pyyaml is absent from the venv, pip install pyyaml into the venv first — environment provisioning is permitted for gates) and that the exact commands CI runs pass locally.

nodes.title: End-to-end integration tests with synthetic media
nodes.spec:
`scripts/make_fixture.py`: stdlib-only generator writing small WAV files (wave + math modules: 16kHz mono 16-bit, sine sweep + silence, ~1-2s, a few KB) — used to (re)generate `tests/fixtures/*.wav`; commit the generated fixtures (tone.wav, speechlike.wav — amplitude-modulated multi-tone so VAD paths see energy variation; and silence.wav).

`tests/test_integration.py` (all offline via `--engine mock` / MockEngine, exercising the REAL CLI process surface):
- CliRunner end-to-end over the fixtures directory: transcribe to every available format at once into an output dir; assert every expected file exists; parse the JSON output back with Transcript.from_dict; regex-validate SRT cue structure and VTT header; tsv header.
- Batch isolation: copy a fixture to `FAIL_case.wav`, run batch, assert exit code 1, good files still produced, error mentions the failing file.
- Determinism: run twice with overwrite, byte-identical outputs.
- Subprocess smoke (marked, still offline): `subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "transcriber", "--version"])` and `... transcribe fixture --engine mock --stdout -f txt` in a tmp cwd asserting clean stdout and exit 0 — proves console entry path works outside CliRunner.
Keep runtime under ~10s total.

nodes.title: Packaging: build, twine check, clean-venv install smoke
nodes.spec:
Make the distribution real and prove it installs (docs has landed, so README.md exists).

- Finalise `pyproject.toml` metadata: add `readme = "README.md"`, project URLs (Homepage/Issues pointing at github.com/AlpharomeroJL/Transcriber), and double-check classifiers/keywords/license wiring.
- `scripts/smoke_install.sh` (bash, `set -euo pipefail`): rm -rf dist; `.venv/bin/python -m build` (sdist+wheel); `.venv/bin/twine check dist/*`; create a throwaway venv in a mktemp dir; pip install the built wheel into it (deps resolve from PyPI, that is fine); run `<tmpvenv>/bin/transcriber --version`, `--help`, `formats`, and a mock-engine transcription of a small generated tmp wav asserting the output file exists and exit 0; verify `py.typed` IS in the wheel and `.graphloop`, `tests`, `scripts` are NOT (python -m zipfile -l); verify LICENSE and README.md are in the sdist (python -m tarfile -l); clean up the tmp venv; print PASS.

nodes.title: Adversarial cross-cutting review (read-only)
nodes.gate: test -s .graphloop/artifacts/review.json && python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('.graphloop/artifacts/review.json')); assert isinstance(d.get('findings'), list); print(len(d['findings']), 'findings')"
nodes.spec: Read-only adversarial review of the whole repository (a Wave-A recon lane per the packet protocol; editing any source file is lane failure). Hunt cross-module bugs the per-node gates cannot see: contract mismatches between modules (config fields unused by engines, formatter/CLI drift), packaging vs runtime drift (entry point vs actual function, wheel contents), error-handling gaps (what does a user see on a corrupt file, a missing model, no network?), CLI UX inconsistencies (help text vs behaviour, exit codes), doc drift (README examples that would not run verbatim), test blind spots (paths never executed), security-adjacent issues (shell injection in scripts, path traversal on output naming, temp-file races). Verify suspicions by running commands (allowed: execution is not editing). Deliver `.graphloop/artifacts/review.json`: {"node": "review", "findings": [{"severity": "high|med|low", "file": ..., "claim": ..., "evidence": "command + observed output proving it", "suggested_fix": ...}], "summary": ...}. Report honestly: an empty findings list is a valid outcome only with evidence of what was probed.

nodes.title: Fix review findings, full gauntlet, version-complete
nodes.gate: .venv/bin/ruff check . && .venv/bin/ruff format --check . && .venv/bin/mypy src && .venv/bin/pytest --cov=transcriber --cov-fail-under=85 -q && bash scripts/smoke_install.sh && .venv/bin/python scripts/check_docs.py
nodes.spec: Orchestrator-run closing node. Triage every review finding: fix high/med severity items (with regression tests where applicable), ledger explicitly any accepted-as-is low items with rationale. Close any loose ends noted in wave artifacts (e.g. pack node's readme wiring). Run the full gauntlet gate on a clean tree; then best-effort real-model smoke (scripts/smoke_real.py, env-gated, downloads tiny model — record outcome as evidence either way, network permitting; not part of the gate). Confirm `graphloop.py complete` and commit.
